sources.quote: Gliese 12 is a red dwarf star located 39.7 light-years away in the constellation Pisces.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Turner et al. 2026.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Gliese 12"
sources.quote: It has about 24% the mass and 26% the radius of the Sun, and a temperature of about 3,296 K. It is an inactive star and hosts one known exoplanet.
